system.description:
This jutsu requires an active thunderstorm to cast. You create an opposite magnetic pull from the thunder cloud calling upon all of the lightning that the cloud has built up onto a single space you can see within range. This attack affects an area in the shape of a cylinder 40 feet wide, and 500 feet tall, extending into the sky.

Creatures in the range of the lightning Bolt must make a Dexterity saving throw. A flying creature makes their saving throw at disadvantage.

On a failed save, affected creatures take 10d12 lightning damage, gains 5 ranks of Shocked and are Dazed until they are no longer Shocked on a failed Save and half as much damage on a successful one.
